title: VOC and EIC
notes: This is a small seed, not a complete atlas. Pre-1500 and most early-modern tracks are historical reconstructions with a citation each. The only logbook track is the CLIWOC LAUNCESTON cruise of 1769. DAS contributes two real voyage records; their paths are reconstructed. The full CLIWOC and DAS corpora were not drawn.

routes.name: DAS 0001.1 Amsterdam (Texel to Enggano, 1595–1596)
routes.citation: J. R. Bruijn, F. S. Gaastra and I. Schöffer, Dutch-Asiatic Shipping in the 17th and 18th Centuries, 3 vols. (The Hague: Martinus Nijhoff, 1979-1987), voyages 0001.1-0004.1. Dates typed from the published compilation; the online DAS database is not bundled.
routes.notes: Real voyage dates: the first Dutch fleet to the East Indies (Houtman), Texel 1595-04-02 to Enggano 1596-06-06. Track reconstructed along the pre-Brouwer route; not daily positions. The four ships of this first fleet (DAS 0001.1-0004.1) sail together on their recorded dates; the spacing between them is only for visibility.
